name: Muramite Citadel: Laboratory
summary: An arcane laboratory where Muramite Inquisitors experiment with Discord energy and living subjects.
description: The Laboratory is the arcane workshop of the Muramite Citadel. Inquisitors conduct experiments on Discord energy, Dragorn captives, and arcane constructs. Ritual tables, containment vats, and Discord‑charged instruments fill the chamber. The air hums with unstable energy, and the stone walls pulse with arcane resonance. Failed experiments roam freely, and Discord anomalies erupt unpredictably. Only the most trusted Inquisitors may enter this chamber.
